name: Computerised maintenance management and work management
principle: The CMMS (or enterprise asset management system) is the operational record of every physical asset: equipment hierarchy, failure history, work orders, permits and spare-parts stock. Work management turns that record into a pipeline — backlog prioritised by risk, planned jobs kitted with materials, scheduled into windows that respect process constraints, executed with capture of as-found/as-left condition, then reviewed in bad-actor and reliability analyses that feed back into inspection and strategy decisions. Its value depends entirely on data discipline: a CMMS full of duplicate hierarchies and un-closed work orders drives worse decisions than paper.

process_steps.name: Asset register and hierarchy maintained from engineering data
Work requests screened, prioritised and planned with materials
Jobs scheduled into windows agreed with operations
Failure and cost history analysed; strategies updated
